component.name: Spot
component.summary: Find and start apps from the keyboard

description.p: Press Super+Space, type a few letters and press Enter. Spot finds installed applications and AppImages, learns which ones you pick, and answers a few things directly:

ul.li: Lock, log out, suspend, restart and power off
Web addresses and files or folders by path
A web search when nothing else fits

description.p: AppImages are found in your Applications, Downloads and Desktop folders without being run, and are started correctly even when the old libfuse2 is missing.
Spot uses a small GNOME Shell extension for its shortcut, so it opens instantly and never loses what you start typing.
First release: apps, AppImages, learned ranking, calculator, system actions, URLs and paths, web search, and a setup window.
